parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure it is unique across different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description:
Service instance ID.

You can obtain the service instance ID by calling [ListServiceInstances - Query Service Instance List](~~396200~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier rollback-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-3a8f9a75da074f52b969 --client-token 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --region cn-hangzhou
